Thanks, Peter — confirmed on our side for Tue 1/24 10am PT. Small heads-up: when external invites are forwarded into a different G Suite domain or to a shared alias, the original organizer sometimes loses organizer permissions in Google Calendar. That can strip host-level controls on Meet links (mute/unmute, admitting attendees), which breaks our typical remote-control demo flow.

Two quick options:
- Keep the Meet invite but we ask you to keep the original organizer (your scheduling assistant) as the organizer so we can ask them to admit/spotlight attendees at the start.
- Or switch to a short Zoom link we control and provision a temporary host account so we retain host controls regardless of how the invite is forwarded. Zoom would also let us hand a PST dial-in + local numbers in the confirmation.

Ben, can you propose a short-lived Zoom meeting and the temp-host steps if we go that route? Kimberly, looping you since this touches guest admission and SSO edge cases we've seen.

Ava
